mathematical_meanings: Left image: The hollow endpoint is excluded from the displayed function graph, indicating that the shown function value is not attained at that endpoint. Right image: The hollow endpoint is excluded from the displayed function graph, indicating that the shown function value is not attained at that endpoint.
